description_en: Modifies a scaling configuration by specifying parameters such as the ID of the scaling configuration to be modified, the name of the scaling configuration, and the attributes of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI), such as the instance restart policy, the preemption policy, and the bandwidth of the elastic IP address (EIP)
description_zh: 调用ModifyEciScalingConfiguration，并可以指定待修改伸缩配置的ID、伸缩配置的名称、ECI实例的属性等参数，修改伸缩配置，例如实例重启策略、实例的抢占策略、弹性公网 IP 的带宽等信息
name: ModifyEciScalingConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling configuration to be modified
parameters.help_zh: 待修改伸缩配置的ID
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling configuration. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length, and can contain digits, letters, and Chinese characters. It must start with a digit, a letter, or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

The name of a scaling configuration must be unique within a scaling group in a region. If you do not specify this parameter, the ID of the scaling configuration is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩配置的名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符，以数字、大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）或半角句号（.）。

在同一地域下同一伸缩组内伸缩配置名称唯一。如果您没有指定该参数，则默认使用伸缩配置的ID
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_name

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数未开放使用
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the security group to which the ECI instance belongs. ECI instances in the same security group can access each other.

If you do not specify a security group, the system automatically uses the default security group in the selected region. You must ensure that the inbound rules of the security group include the protocols and ports that the containers need to expose. If no default security group exists in the region, the system performs automatic creation of a default security group and adds the declared container protocols and ports to the inbound rules of the security group
parameters.help_zh:
ECI实例所属的安全组ID。同一个安全组内的ECI实例之间可以互相访问。

如果没有指定安全组，系统将自动使用您选择的地域下的默认安全组，您需要确保该安全组的入方向规则中包含容器需要暴露的协议和端口。如果您在该地域下没有默认安全组，系统将自动创建一个默认安全组，并将您声明的容器协议和端口添加到该安全组的入方向规则中
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the ECI, which is the name of the container group. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and cannot start or end with a hyphen (-)
parameters.help_zh:
ECI实例名称，即容器组名称。格式要求如下：

长度为2~128个字符。
支持英文小写字母、数字或者短划线（-），不能以短划线（-）开头或者结尾

fields.name: stdin

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the standard input stream maintains the enabling status across multiple attached sessions when standard input is true.

If StdinOnce is set to true, standard input is opened when the container starts, remains empty until the first client attaches to it, and then maintains the enabling status to accept data until the client disconnects. After the client disconnects, standard input enters shutdown and remains in shutdown until the container is restarted
fields.help_zh:
当标准输入为true时，标准输入流将在多个附加会话中是否保持开启状态。

如果StdinOnce设为true，标准输入在容器开启时被打开，在首个客户端附加到标准输入之前都为空，然后会一直保持开启状态，接收数据，直到客户端连接断开，此时标准输入被关闭，在容器重启前一直保持关闭状态
fields.name: stdin_once

fields.help_en:

The mount propagation settings for the volume. Mount propagation allows volumes mounted by a container to be shared with other containers in the same pod, or even with other pods on the same node. Valid values:

None: The volume does not receive any subsequent mounts that are performed on the volume or its subdirectories.
HostToCotainer: The volume receives all subsequent mounts that are performed on the volume or its subdirectories.

Bidirectional：和HostToCotainer类似，能感知挂载操作。另外，该卷将被传播回主机和使用同一卷的所有Pod的所有容器

parameters.help_en:
The level of the instance family. This parameter is used to filter instance types that meet your requirements and takes effect only when CostOptimization is set to true. Valid values:

EntryLevel: shared instance types. Shared instance types are more cost-effective but cannot guarantee stable computing performance. They are suitable for business scenarios with low CPU utilization. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/108489.html.
EnterpriseLevel: enterprise-level instance types. Enterprise-level instance types provide stable performance and dedicated resources. They are suitable for business scenarios that require high stability. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html.
CreditEntryLevel: burstable instance types. Burstable instance types use CPU credits to ensure computing performance. They are suitable for business scenarios with low CPU utilization but occasional CPU usage spikes. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59977.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格族级别，用于筛选符合要求的实例规格范围，当`CostOptimization`开启时生效。取值范围：

EntryLevel：入门级，即共享型实例规格。成本更低，但是无法保证实例计算性能的稳定。适用于平时CPU使用率低的业务场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/108489.html。
EnterpriseLevel：企业级。性能稳定且资源独享，适用于对稳定性要求高的业务场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html。
CreditEntryLevel：积分入门级，即突发性能实例。通过CPU积分来保证计算性能，适用于平时CPU使用率低、偶有突发CPU使用率的业务场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59977.html
parameters.name: instance_family_level

parameters.help_en:
The control parameter for the update method of the Containers parameter. Valid values:

RenewUpdate: full update. The Containers parameter in the update request prevails and overwrites the original Containers parameter configuration.
IncrementalUpdate: incremental update. Containers are matched based on Container.name, and only the parameters specified in the request are updated.

Default value: RenewUpdate
parameters.help_zh:
Containers参数更新方式控制参数。取值范围：

RenewUpdate：全量更新，以更新请求中Containers参数为准，覆盖原有Containers参数配置。
IncrementalUpdate：增量更新，根据Container.name进行Container匹配，仅更新请求参数中已设置参数，未设置参数不进行更新。

默认值：RenewUpdate
parameters.name: containers_update_type

parameters.help_en:
The performance level of the cloud disk used for data caching. Use ESSDs. Valid values for the performance level of an ESSD:

PL0: A single ESSD can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: A single ESSD can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: A single ESSD can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: A single ESSD can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Default value: PL1.

For more information about ESSDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据缓存使用的云盘的性能等级。建议优先使用ESSD云盘，该云盘的性能等级取值范围：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万。

默认值：PL1。

关于ESSD云盘的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: data_cache_pl

parameters.help_en:
The provisioned read and write IOPS of the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk used for data caching. Valid values: 0 to min{50000, 1000 × capacity - baseline performance}, where baseline performance = min{1800 + 50 × capacity, 50000}.

For more information about ESSD AutoPL cloud disks, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据缓存使用ESSD AutoPL云盘时，ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。取值范围：0~min{50000, 1000容量-基准性能}，其中，基准性能=min{1800+50容量, 50000}。

关于ESSD AutoPL云盘的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
parameters.name: data_cache_provisioned_iops
